headline: Anthropic Revenue Jumps to $16.8 Billion in Quarter Before IPO
headline_vi: Doanh thu của Anthropic tăng lên 16,8 tỷ USD trong quý trước IPO
summary: Anthropic PBC told prospective investors its third-quarter revenue hit $16.8 billion, according to people familiar with the matter, as the artificial intelligence model maker pushes ahead with plans to go public.
